title: goya-zcode: read-only native ZCode session monitor (increment 1 of frontend rebuild)

scope.objective: First increment of rebuilding the drowzy frontend on Goya: a native Wayland window that connects to a ZCode CLI app-server over the NDJSON protocol and live-mirrors a session's status and streaming transcript tail. Full frontend replacement remains blocked on Goya platform gaps (no text wrapping, no editable text field, no scrolling, ASCII-only keyboard) — see docs/goya-zcode.md non-goals.
exclusions: drowzy monorepo: zero code changes (it only serves its existing stdio protocol)

implementation_record.contract: docs/goya-zcode.md defines inputs, projection state, scene contract, acceptance, non-goals.
implementation_record.protocol: Minimal client for the strict NDJSON channel of `zcode app-server`: requests {id, method, params}; responses {id, result|error}; notifications session/event, state.updated (inert). Consumed methods: session/list ({workspace:{workspacePath, workspaceKey}} — local identity rule workspaceKey = trimmed path), session/subscribe ({sessionId, deliveryKind:'desktop-continuous'}). Handled event types: turn.started, part.delta (field text), turn.completed, turn.failed; all others inert. Response schemas verified against drowzy packages/shared/src/zcode-protocol/index.ts (zcodeEventEnvelopeSchema, zcodeSessionListParamsSchema, zcodeSessionSubscribeParamsSchema, zcodeSessionEventSchema).
implementation_record.ownership: Agent thread is the sole writer of SessionView (Mutex) + dirty AtomicBool; render loop only reads snapshots (dirty-flag poll, no channel). Reader thread routes responses into a pending map and applies events to the view; requests are serialised through &mut ChildStdin ownership. Unknown events are inert; non-JSON stdout frames mark link down; reconnect backoff 5s.
implementation_record.projection: view.rs: bounded tail (14 wrapped lines, fixed width 56 chars — manual wrap because Goya has no text wrapping), streaming buffer flushed in chunks; turn lifecycle maps to status idle/running/error. Pure logic, unit-tested.
implementation_record.scene: apps/zcode-monitor.gscene: header (title/status), row_00..row_13 transcript rows, quit button. Host overrides node text each frame (calculator with_result pattern); --watch transactional hot-swap via SceneStore::swap.

acceptance.unit: cargo test -p goya-zcode: 6 passed (wrap width, hard split, tail bound+order, turn lifecycle, failed turn, rows fill).
acceptance.clippy_fmt: cargo clippy -p goya-zcode --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean. cargo fmt applied.
acceptance.headless: cargo run --bin zcode-monitor: scene has title/status/quit [PASS], 14/14 rows [PASS], projection turn lifecycle [PASS], hit test quit [PASS].
acceptance.live: zcode-monitor --stdin-dump --cli <node wrapper of drowzy apps/zcode-cli/packages/cli/dist/zcode.cjs> --workspace /home/sal/drowzy --duration 30: link Connecting -> Up, session/list returned the workspace sessions, subscribed to newest session ('Rebuild Frontend Using Goya', status idle). Tail empty is expected: subscribe without afterSeq streams only events after subscription and the session was idle. part.delta streaming path is covered by unit tests.
acceptance.live_limitations: A turn was not started during acceptance (avoids consuming provider tokens); live streaming delivery is proven by protocol capture of session/event notifications from the same server surface the TUI consumes, plus the unit-tested projection. rustdoc doctests are excluded per the known host LLVM issue stated in README.
